outlook.statement: Company has started concentrating on manufacture of finer counts of yarn; secured significant orders from Government of India, Ministry of Defence for 15,000 sets of Extreme Cold Weather Clothing System (Suit) to be supplied before June 2026; further order for 24,585 sets from Department of Military Affairs, Indian Army to be supplied during FY 2026-27.
Considering the Government's various initiatives in support of the Indian Textile Industry, the outlook continues to be an optimistic one.
